stimulus.body: Case file: 178 values are listed with identifiers and recorded values for an audit of place value in binary.

questions.stem: The case below gives the figures. A telemetry file holds 178 readings, each labelled place value in binary, and an analyst must classify them. What does place value in binary mean in this record?

options.text: Each position adds ten moving left
options.misconception: Applies decimal place value to binary
Treats binary places as equal weight
Reverses the direction of doubling

questions.explanation: place value in binary: In binary the rightmost bit has weight one and each position to the left doubles, so position k has weight two to the k. Option C is correct: Each position doubles moving left. Option A is wrong because it applies decimal place value to binary. Option B is wrong because it treats binary places as equal weight. Option D is wrong because it reverses the direction of doubling.
questions.hint: Start from one on the right and double per place.
